title: **Converted files need a shell copy** — the filesystem service creates no binary files, so the model copies each temporary file with the shell. Deployments without a shell tool cannot deliver converted files, and the temporary file is delet...

attrs.text: **Converted files need a shell copy** — the filesystem service creates no binary files, so the model copies each temporary file with the shell. Deployments without a shell tool cannot deliver converted files, and the temporary file is deleted after the Office kit's retention or when the root Session of the caller's subagent tree is disposed; a file a subagent produced stays after that subagent ends.

title: **No conversion on remote workspaces** — the Office kit runs on the Host, and a remote shell cannot read its output store.

title: **Web GUI does not display rendered images** — the [ui-tool](../../client/ui-tool/README.md) Office row shows the text blocks of an `office_render` result and omits its images, so the user does not see the pages the model inspected. The mod...

attrs.text: **Web GUI does not display rendered images** — the [ui-tool](../../client/ui-tool/README.md) Office row shows the text blocks of an `office_render` result and omits its images, so the user does not see the pages the model inspected. The model still receives every image.

title: **Native engine in the Host process** — rendering, conversion, and recalculation that the model starts run the native LibreOffice Kit engine inside the Host process through `ctx.officeKit`, so the shell sandbox and PTC permissions do not co...

attrs.text: **Native engine in the Host process** — rendering, conversion, and recalculation that the model starts run the native LibreOffice Kit engine inside the Host process through `ctx.officeKit`, so the shell sandbox and PTC permissions do not confine them. Inputs remain subject to the filesystem backend's read authority. The native parser processes an untrusted document with the Host user's permissions.

title: **PTC activation does not survive resume or fork** — the PTC request header records only `run_code`, so a resumed or forked PTC Agent offers no Office bindings until the model loads an Office skill again; the removal and the re-addition eac...

attrs.text: **PTC activation does not survive resume or fork** — the PTC request header records only `run_code`, so a resumed or forked PTC Agent offers no Office bindings until the model loads an Office skill again; the removal and the re-addition each rewrite the system prompt, with the cache effect described under KV Cache effect.

title: **Plugin reload clears activation** — hot reload, or disabling and re-enabling the plugin, clears the in-memory marks. If a step runs in the meantime, its request header omits the three tools, and the model must load an Office skill again t...

attrs.text: **Plugin reload clears activation** — hot reload, or disabling and re-enabling the plugin, clears the in-memory marks. If a step runs in the meantime, its request header omits the three tools, and the model must load an Office skill again to restore them.

title: **Direct invocation activates from the next step** — the tool set of a step is fixed before the content of a user-invoked skill such as `/office` is injected, so the first model request after the invocation declares no Office tools. The too...

attrs.text: **Direct invocation activates from the next step** — the tool set of a step is fixed before the content of a user-invoked skill such as `/office` is injected, so the first model request after the invocation declares no Office tools. The tools appear from the next model step.

title: Rendering fidelity, fonts, and pagination follow LibreOffice Kit and can differ from Microsoft Office.
